sources: [Stage -1 correction, 2026-07-14] PRIMARY-SOURCE CONFIRMED 2026-07-14 (thehackernews/csoonline/whitewebsecurity coverage of CVE-2026-5721 OAuth-secret-leak research): the actual precedent methodology is NOT a Shodan credential dork — a researcher harvested AMQP-listener population from Shodan on port 5672, THEN separately active-scanned port 15672 on that population and attempted guest/guest, finding 882 hosts running rabbitmq_management_plugin, 518 (59%) accepting guest/guest remotely despite the loopback_users default. This is a two-stage harvest-then-verify pattern, not a single dork — adopt it: Shodan harvest on product:"RabbitMQ" / port 5672,15672 population, defer credential-test to the verify (3v) stage, never claim guest/guest exposure from a dork alone.
